observations: Photo 0: Side view of a smartphone with a flat edge, volume buttons, and a power button. The phone has a dark blue or black finish. The background shows a glass display cabinet and wooden paneling, likely a store.

Photo 1: Front view of the phone showing the iOS home screen with app icons. The screen displays 'Waiting...' under each app, suggesting the phone is not fully responsive or is in a simulated state. The time is 07:57, and the status bar shows a battery icon and signal strength. The notch is present, typical of iPhone models from iPhone X onwards.

Photo 2: Back view of the phone with a triple-camera system arranged in a square module, typical of iPhone 12 Pro or later models. A white sticker is affixed to the back with printed text: 'Great A+', 'Battery 85%', '100% Tether', 'Camera Pass', '100% Unlocked', 'Color: Pacific Blue', 'Testing Pass', 'TAM', 'Denaco'. The phone is dark blue, matching 'Pacific Blue' description. The sticker also includes a barcode.
All photos have a watermark: 'POSTED ON JIJI DENACO COMMUNICATION'.
